card.name: The word of before enzyme or drug names
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after metabolism or metabolizer terms or levels, just before a CYP enzyme or drug name. It also fires on a few linking words like "with" in drug-interaction text.

modes.label: Levels of a drug

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: A linking word or letter inside gene or interaction phrases.
